nodes.name: GET Available Slots
nodes.notes: Cal.com v2 slots API, looked up by eventTypeId (a numeric ID from the event type's Cal.com dashboard URL, e.g. app.cal.com/event-types/12345678 -> 12345678) rather than username/slug -- confirmed live (executions 903, 905) that GET /v2/slots rejects a username-based lookup for a single personal event ('usernames must be an array...must contain at least 2 elements', i.e. that parameter combination is actually for team/org dynamic booking pages, not a single event type). eventTypeId is the documented, evidence-backed working identifier. Requires the CAL_COM_EVENT_TYPE_ID n8n variable to be set; if it's unset (empty eventTypeId) or the API call fails for any other reason, neverError + the empty-list fallback in Parse Available Slots means this just quietly contributes no slots rather than breaking the booking email.

nodes.name: Parse Available Slots
nodes.notes: Flattens Cal.com's date-keyed slots object into a flat list and takes the first 3 upcoming ones. Labels are stated explicitly in UTC rather than guessing the lead's timezone -- there's no per-lead timezone data in this system to convert to, and a wrong guess is worse than an honest UTC label.

nodes.name: Gmail: Send Booking Email
nodes.notes: Switched from Postmark (blocked by its pending-approval domain restriction) to Gmail, reusing the same gmailOAuth2 credential Agent 4 already uses to poll replies.

nodes.name: Extract Gmail Message Id
nodes.notes: Gmail's API throws its own error on failure, so this just reshapes the response into the {messageId} shape Sign: Report Meeting Offer already expects.
